title: vFlow: Visual Flow Cytometry & Immunofluorescence Analysis Tool
description: vFlow is a desktop application for interactive 2D gating, visualisation, and quantification of flow-cytometry and single-particle immunofluorescence data from FCS or CSV list-mode files. Version 4.3.0 combines the package refactor with scientific-correctness, FCS/CSV, gate-provenance, transform, polar-analysis, batch-analysis, runtime-regression and refactor-integrity hardening.
